name: Torikago no Uso
source:
I'm trapped in a prison.
Can I get out of this dark and cold place surrounded by stone walls on all sides?

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21980]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我被關在牢獄裡。
四面都是石牆，陰暗而寒冷，我能夠離開這裡嗎？
